title: Omurice (Japanese Ketchup Chicken Rice with Soft Omelette)
summary: Day-old rice toasted in batches, tossed with chicken, onion, carrot and ketchup, moulded into domes and covered with a softly set omelette. Finished with a zigzag of ketchup.
equipment: 25 cm non-stick or carbon-steel frying pan

ingredients.item: cooked short-grain rice, preferably a day old
boneless, skinless chicken thigh, diced 1 cm
tomato ketchup, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.text: Break the cold rice into separate grains with your fingers. Heat 1 tbsp oil in the pan over high heat and stir-fry half the rice for about 3 min until lightly toasted, then set aside and repeat with the rest. Working in batches keeps the pan hot, so the rice fries rather than steams.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Add 2 tbsp oil to the pan and fry the onion and carrot for 3 min until they start to brown. Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 min, stirring, until cooked through (74 °C).

steps.title: Coat with ketchup
steps.text: Return all the rice, add the ketchup thinned with the water and toss until every grain is glossy and evenly red. Stir through the spring onion and pepper.

steps.title: Mould
steps.text: Pack half the rice into the small bowl and turn it out onto a plate as a neat dome. Repeat with the rest on the second plate.

steps.title: Make the omelettes
steps.text: Wipe out the pan and heat half the remaining oil over medium-high heat. Pour in half the beaten eggs with the salt and stir rapidly while shaking the pan for 1-2 min, until softly set but still glossy, then spread into a round and slide it over a rice dome. Repeat, then finish each with a zigzag of ketchup.

tips: Freshly cooked rice turns mushy; spread it on a tray and chill it for an hour if it isn't a day old.
A drizzle of tomato sauce simmered with a little stock is a richer alternative to plain ketchup.
safety: Egg safety: a soft, glossy omelette needs pasteurised eggs. Otherwise cook it until just set throughout (71 °C). Pregnant people, young children, older adults and anyone with weakened immunity should eat only fully set eggs.
storage: Best eaten straight away. The ketchup rice keeps in the fridge for 2 days; reheat until piping hot (74 °C) and make the omelette fresh. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
